comment: Reboot gate for the S10+ (beyond2lte), installed to /etc/nuxel/buttons/reboot-gate.json. This is the ONLY thing that decides whether a very-long power press or the power-menu Restart/Power-off entry may actually act. It is closed by default. Rationale: this mission runs with the owner absent; a reboot that does not return to Nuxel, or a phone left powered off, would be unrecoverable without the owner. The mission permits ordinary reboots only with a known-working userspace rollback path and a pre/post-reboot checklist.

policy_source_contract.comment: bg-09 owns the reboot policy. When this file exists and carries allow_reboot: true, the gate treats it as an additional permission (AND, not OR, with this file's own flags) so neither group can silently override the other.

refusal_reason: gate closed: owner absent and no repository-side reboot policy has authorised a restart in this cycle

execution.comment: Only a userspace reboot path is ever used. Nothing here talks to a bootloader, a partition or a block device.
